questions.target: 并列信息 / 主语对象
questions.skill: 正确选项可对应并列句一侧
questions.q: A critic writes: “The study gives a detailed history of the device but offers little investigation of the failures reported in cold weather.” Two sentences later: “The device’s clearest flaw is that its battery loses capacity after repeated freezing.” What does the study fail to do?
o: provide any historical background
investigate the cold-weather failures sufficiently
prevent the battery from losing capacity
make the device work indefinitely in freezing conditions

exp.trans: 评论者说研究对设备历史讲得很详细，但对寒冷天气中的故障调查不足。后面说设备本身最明显的缺陷是反复结冰后电池容量下降。题目问study，因此答案是调查不足。
exp.structure: but连接两个对study的评价：history详细，failure investigation不足；后句The device’s clearest flaw把主语切到device。
exp.other: capacity 容量；freezing 冰冻环境；investigation 调查；critic 评论者。
exp.meaning: 并列句里一半信息就可以被题目抽出来做同义替换。不要因为答案没同时复述history和failure两侧就排除。
exp.rest: “provide any historical background”与detailed history相反；要求study去prevent battery loss或让device indefinitely work in freezing conditions，都是把研究报告与设备本身的职责混在一起。

questions.target: 个人估计 vs 集体验证
questions.skill: 区分主张起点和取得认可所需条件
questions.q: An analyst estimates that the city has room for 4,000 people in emergency shelters. Officials will use this figure for evacuation plans only after independent teams verify the counts and agree on a common estimate. What makes the figure suitable for official planning?
o: The analyst's personal familiarity with the shelters.
Verification and agreement across independent teams.
The public release of a large numerical estimate.
The analyst's decision to avoid revising the original number.

exp.trans: 一位分析员估计城市应急避难所可容纳4000人；只有独立团队核查数据并就统一估计达成一致，政府才会在疏散计划中采用这一数字。
exp.structure: An analyst + estimates + that从句提出最初主张；Officials + will use + this figure ... only after ...，only after指出主张转化为官方依据所需的条件。
exp.other: emergency shelter 应急避难所；evacuation 疏散；estimate 估计；verify 核验。
exp.meaning: 题干问的是让一项初步主张获得认可所需要的机制。个人估计是起点，独立团队核查与达成一致是条件；不能因为看到analyst就选个人经验。
exp.rest: 个人熟悉情况只能解释估计如何产生；数字公开和规模大都不能自动证明可靠；拒绝修订反而与核查机制相冲突。

questions.q: After a notoriously drawn-out hearing, campaigners rallied local residents to oppose the plan. Which interpretation best matches the sentence?
o: 听证会异常简短，因此活动人士解散了居民。
经过众所周知旷日持久的听证会，活动人士动员当地居民反对计划。
听证会从未进行，居民被要求保持中立。
活动人士隐瞒了整个听证会，因此居民改变了政治立场。

exp.trans: 在一次众所周知拖延了很久的听证会之后，活动人士动员当地居民反对这项计划。
exp.structure: After a ... hearing是时间状语；campaigners + rallied + local residents是主谓宾；to oppose the plan说明动员的行动方向。
exp.other: hearing 听证会；campaigner 活动人士；resident 居民；oppose 反对。
exp.meaning: notoriously=众所周知地、臭名昭著地（通常有负面色彩）；drawn-out=拖延很久的、旷日持久的；rally作动词=动员、召集。动员不自动证明居民改变了原有政治态度。
exp.rest: 简短与drawn-out相反；从未举行和保持中立均无依据；隐瞒听证会与改变政治立场都是额外增添的动作。

questions.q:
段A：The museum lowered ticket prices and added evening hours.
段B：Such changes attracted more local families during the week.
段C：A different museum across town raised its prices last year.

段B中的 Such changes 最直接回指什么？
o: 段A中的降价和延长晚间开放时间
段C中另一家博物馆的涨价
所有博物馆过去一年的变化
local families 本身

diag.1: 段B先于段C，且 Such changes 就近概括段A的两个措施。
diag.2: 题干没有支持“所有博物馆”的泛指。
diag.3: changes 指的是措施变化，不是家庭。

exp.trans: A：博物馆降低了票价，并延长了晚间开放时间。B：这些变化吸引了更多本地家庭在工作日前来。C：城另一边的另一家博物馆去年提高了票价。
exp.structure: 段A先给出两个并列措施 lowered ticket prices / added evening hours；段B用 Such changes 对这两个措施整体回指，再说明结果 attracted more local families。
exp.other: lower 降低；ticket price 票价；evening hours 晚间开放时段；attract 吸引。
exp.meaning: such + 名词 常把前文已经描述过的同类事物/情况概括回指；这里 Such changes = 段A的两项变化。
exp.rest: 后文另一家博物馆的涨价、所有博物馆的泛指以及 local families 都不是 Such changes 的先行内容；它直接概括前文的降价和延长晚间开放时间。

questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.q:
The bakery opened at six, with warm bread cooling on the counter.
with 后面的结构主要起什么作用？
o: 补充开门时伴随的状态
引出老板的直接引语
说明开门的唯一目的
充当opened的直接宾语

exp.trans: 面包店六点开门，当时温热的面包正在柜台上晾凉。
exp.structure: 主干：The bakery（主语）+ opened（不及物谓语）+ at six（时间状语）。原始简单句Warm bread was cooling on the counter → 去掉was，用with引出：with warm bread cooling on the counter。warm bread是with结构的逻辑主语，cooling是与之构成主动关系的现在分词。
exp.other: bakery 面包店；cool 晾凉、变凉；counter 柜台；warm 温热的。
exp.meaning: with复合结构可以补充主句发生时的伴随状态；它不是新的独立主句。
exp.rest: 直接引语通常由say等动词引出，此处没有任何说话行为。目的常用to do或in order to，原句只描写伴随状态。opened在本句是不及物用法，with短语不是其直接宾语。

questions.target: 公开工资表 vs 延后福利
questions.q: A port authority's new contract capped immediate wage increases at 2%. Negotiators nevertheless won additional paid leave and retirement payments that workers would receive years later. Why might the published wage table understate the agreement's value?
o: Because future benefits add compensation not visible in current wage increases.
Because the wage table proves that workers lost all holiday entitlement.
Because capped wages show that pensions must have been reduced.
Because only the highest-paid managers can receive retirement benefits.

exp.trans: 港务局新合同将近期工资涨幅限制在2%，但谈判代表争取到更多带薪休假和多年后领取的退休福利。因此只看当前工资表，会低估协议的总体价值。
exp.structure: A port authority's contract + capped + wage increases；Negotiators + won + leave and payments；years later修饰后续领取时间。Why题要解释工资表遗漏了哪一部分。
exp.other: cap 限定上限；port authority 港务局；negotiator 谈判代表；paid leave 带薪休假。
exp.meaning: backloaded compensation指把部分报酬安排在之后或以福利形式提供。不能把工资涨幅不大误读为整体待遇没有提高，更不能凭空判定增长‘过度’。
exp.rest: 原文明确增加假期而非失去假期；养老金被削减与additional retirement payments相反；限定只给高管没有证据。

questions.target: 例子同样可以说明支持改革
questions.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
questions.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

questions.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
questions.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

scope-role-match.target: 题干对象 / 评价对象匹配
scope-role-match.skill: 关键词相似前先核对主语
scope-role-match.q: A review says: “The report contains pages of anecdotes and too little analysis of why small firms avoid the subsidy.” It later adds: “The subsidy’s most serious weakness is that participation falls once temporary bonuses end.” If asked what the report fails to do, which answer is best?
o: explain adequately why small firms avoid the subsidy
produce participation that lasts after bonuses end
remove all anecdotes from the discussion
prove that temporary bonuses never increase participation

exp.trans: 评论先说报告轶事过多，却没有充分分析小企业为何避开补贴；后面又说补贴本身最严重的问题是奖金结束后参与度下降。若题干问“报告没做到什么”，答案应回到报告本身。
exp.structure: 第一句The report是被评价对象；第二句The subsidy’s most serious weakness把评价对象切换成补贴政策。题干再次锁定the report。
exp.other: anecdote 轶事；subsidy 补贴；participation 参与度；temporary bonus 临时奖励。
exp.meaning: 看到most serious weakness之类强信号不能直接选，先检查这个weakness属于谁。正确选项可以只改写并列句中的一侧，不必覆盖整句所有批评。
exp.rest: “produce participation that lasts...”描述的是subsidy的持久效果，不是report的写作缺陷；“remove all anecdotes”把too many夸大成必须全部删除；“prove...never”加入绝对化的never和原文没有的证明要求。

process-stage-role.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
process-stage-role.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
process-stage-role.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

text4-boxed-vocab.q: The unionist became a prominent negotiator in her prime, when she had the energy and experience to lead several major workplace campaigns. Here unionist and in her prime mean:
o: 政府公务员 / 刚开始工作的时候
行业雇主 / 在退休之后
工会人士 / 处于事业或能力的鼎盛时期
独立记者 / 工作经验尚浅时

exp.trans: 这名工会人士在事业巅峰时期成为知名谈判代表，那时她有精力和经验领导数次重大职场行动。
exp.structure: The unionist是主语，became是系动词，a prominent negotiator是表语；in her prime是时间状态状语；when从句解释为什么说她正处鼎盛时期。
exp.other: prominent 知名的；negotiator 谈判代表；workplace 职场；campaign 行动。
exp.meaning: unionist是工会成员或工会活动人士；in one's prime是人生或事业的全盛、鼎盛时期，不是‘在首要位置’。
exp.rest: 公务员、雇主、记者都不能替代工会人士；退休后、经验尚浅都与energy and experience表达的巅峰状态不一致。

text4-boxed-vocab.q: The smaller team had little in the way of legal resources, while its opponent had a fearsome reputation for lengthy court battles. Which translation is accurate?
o: 小团队的法律资源不多，而对手长期诉讼的名声令人畏惧。
小团队在通往法庭的道路上迷路了，而对手声誉良好。
小团队有充足法律资源，对手从不打官司。
小团队为了避免诉讼故意封锁道路。

exp.trans: 这个较小的团队几乎没有多少法律资源，而对手因擅长旷日持久的诉讼而名声令人畏惧。
exp.structure: The smaller team + had + little in the way of legal resources；while连接另一主语its opponent + had + a fearsome reputation。
exp.other: legal resources 法律资源；opponent 对手；reputation 名声；court battle 法庭争讼。
exp.meaning: little/much in the way of sth.表示在某方面拥有的东西少/多；fearsome=令人畏惧的、很强硬可怕的。in the way of在此不是‘挡路’。
exp.rest: 道路与阻挡都误读了in the way of；‘资源充足’和little相反；从不打官司与lengthy court battles不符。

text4-boxed-vocab.q: The laboratory offers generous merit pay to researchers whose work meets demanding performance standards, even though their basic salary is ordinary. What is being described?
o: 根据研究员家庭财产发放的基本工资
所有人的基本工资被削减到同一标准
只奖励研究员在岗年限的津贴
对达到绩效标准的研究者提供优厚的绩效奖金或工资

exp.trans: 实验室为达到严格绩效标准的研究人员提供优厚的绩效报酬，尽管他们的基本工资很普通。
exp.structure: The laboratory + offers + generous merit pay + to researchers；whose work ...定语从句限定哪些研究者；even though引出与基本工资的对比。
exp.other: laboratory 实验室；demanding 严格的、要求高的；performance standard 绩效标准；ordinary 普通的。
exp.meaning: generous修饰待遇时表示丰厚、优厚；merit pay是按能力表现或工作绩效确定的工资或奖金，与basic salary不能简单画等号。
exp.rest: 家庭财产与绩效标准无关；统一削薪未出现；只按资历奖励与performance standards不符。

reference.target: these/such 回指 / 原词复现干扰
reference.skill: 原词复现 vs 明确回指
reference.q:
段A：The team lost radio contact, and its spare battery failed.
段B：These failures forced the team to abandon the search.
段C：Another team tested a radio before leaving camp.

哪两个段落之间的衔接最强？
o: A → C
B → C
C → A
A → B

exp.trans: 段A：团队失去了无线电联系，备用电池也出了故障。段B：这些故障迫使团队放弃搜寻。段C：另一支团队离开营地前测试了一台无线电设备。
exp.structure: 段A有两个并列分句：The team + lost + radio contact；its spare battery + failed。段B：These failures（主语，概括前面的两项故障）+ forced（谓语）+ the team（宾语）+ to abandon the search（宾语补足语）。段C的Another team引入另一对象。
exp.other: radio contact 无线电联系；spare 备用的；abandon 放弃；search 搜寻。
exp.meaning: These failures明确回指已出现的两次故障；重复radio一词并不保证谈的是同一团队、同一事件。
exp.rest: 把两个含radio的句子相接，会忽略Another team造成的对象切换。把这些故障放在另一团队测试设备之前，后句没有承接故障结果。先说另一团队测试再说本团队出故障，也没有明确回指建立连接。

reference.q:
A return is accepted only within thirty days and with a receipt. These requirements apply to online orders too.
These requirements 具体指什么？
o: 网上订单本身
所有商店的规定
三十天以内退货且出示收据这两个条件
退款已经完成这一结果

exp.trans: 只有在三十天内并出示收据，退货才会被受理。这些要求也适用于网上订单。
exp.structure: 第一句：A return（主语）+ is accepted（被动谓语）；only within thirty days和with a receipt并列限制受理条件。第二句：These requirements（主语）+ apply（谓语）+ to online orders（介词短语）。
exp.other: return 退货；receipt 收据；apply to 适用于；online order 网上订单。
exp.meaning: these + 名词可以概括前文的整组条件，不一定只指紧挨着它的一个名词。
exp.rest: online orders是第二句中被这些要求约束的对象，不是要求本身。所有商店的规定扩大了范围，原文未说all shops。退款完成是结果，但前句只陈述受理规则，没有报告任何实际退款。

reference.target: it / this request / 对象切换
reference.q: Two panels examined a report. The finance panel recommended publishing it in full, while the technical panel asked for more time. This request was granted. Which reading tracks it and This request correctly?
o: it = the report; This request = publishing the report in full
it = the finance panel’s recommendation; This request = more time
it = the report; This request = more time for the technical panel
it = the decision to publish; This request = the finance panel’s recommendation

exp.trans: 两个小组审阅了一份报告。财务小组建议全文发布它，技术小组则请求更多时间。这个请求获准了。it指报告；This request指技术小组请求更多时间。
exp.structure: publishing it in full是recommended的补足内容，it代替前文的report。while对比两个小组的不同动作。This request作后句主语；was granted是被动谓语，回指asked for more time这一请求。
exp.other: panel 小组；in full 全文、完整地；technical 技术的；grant a request 批准请求。
exp.meaning: 跟踪对象时既看名词数与位置，也看动作：publish的是report，asked for形成request。财务组的建议和技术组的请求不能混为同一对象。
exp.rest: 把This request指向全文发布，忽略asked for more time和while的对象切换；把it解释成recommendation，会把publish报告改成发布建议；decision to publish也不是it出现前已建立的实体，且没有说发布决定已经获批。

compensation-components.target: 工资涨幅 vs 福利形式
compensation-components.q: The hospital increased nurses' basic pay by only 1%, but expanded subsidized childcare and doubled its contribution to their retirement accounts. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: Every nurse's cash salary doubled.
The hospital eliminated all non-wage benefits.
The overall reward package improved partly through benefits beyond basic pay.
The hospital cut pension support to finance the salary increase.

exp.trans: 医院只把护士的基本工资提高了1%，却扩大了托育补贴，并将其养老金账户的雇主缴费翻倍。合理结论是报酬待遇部分通过工资以外的福利改善。
exp.structure: The hospital + increased + basic pay ... but expanded ... and doubled ...；but对照基本工资小幅增长和两种福利的明显增加，结论应兼顾两边。
exp.other: subsidized childcare 托育补贴；contribution 缴费、投入；retirement account 退休金账户；reward package 总体报酬待遇。
exp.meaning: basic pay / cash salary与benefits / pensions不能混为一谈。工资表面增幅modest并不排除实际待遇因非工资福利而indirectly augmented。
exp.rest: 基本工资翻倍与only 1%冲突；取消福利与expanded相反；削减养老金支持与doubled contribution直接相反。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It proves the article has reached its final sentence.
It summarizes the first phase before the article moves to further analysis.
It introduces a completely unrelated example.
It means the following claim is uncertain.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 总结词可以出现在文章中段，不能凭Overall就判断是最后一句；unrelated example是引例功能，与概括相反；Overall不表达不确定性，uncertain更接近possibly/apparently等语气词。

summary-location.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
summary-location.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。
